acquisition_method.evidence: The mass spectrometer was operated in a so-called Top10 data acquisition approach.

cleavage_agent.evidence: For each sample, 100 µg of total protein was digested using a 1:20 trypsin:protein ratio in a two-step digestion approach (sequencing grade modified porcine trypsin, Promega, Madison, WI, USA).

collision_energy.evidence: Based on each full scan spectrum, the 10 most abundant ions above an intensity of 1.0 × 105 (“underfill ratio”: 0.7%) were selected for fragmentation using a stepped higher energy collisional dissociation regime (stepped HCD, NCE 35 +/− 25%) and an isolation width of 2 Da.

For the exclusion list runs, the 10 most abundant ions above an intensity of 1.0 × 104 (“underfill ratio”: 0.1%) were selected for fragmentation using a stepped higher energy collisional dissociation regime (stepped HCD, NCE 30 +/− 25%) and an isolation width of 1.2 Da.

fractionation_method.evidence: Labeled samples were combined into one set of samples prior to strong cation exchange (SCX) fractionation (100 × 2.1 mm PolySULFOETHYL A column, 5 µm particles, 300 Å pore size, PolyLc Inc., Columbia, MD, USA) using an ÄKTA purifier system (GE Healthcare Life Sciences, Uppsala, Sweden).

fragmentation_method.evidence: Based on each full scan spectrum, the 10 most abundant ions above an intensity of 1.0 × 105 (“underfill ratio”: 0.7%) were selected for fragmentation using a stepped higher energy collisional dissociation regime (stepped HCD, NCE 35 +/− 25%) and an isolation width of 2 Da.

instrument.evidence: Samples were analyzed on a Q Exactive mass spectrometer interfaced with an Easy-nLC 1000 nano LC system (both Thermo Fisher Scientific, Inc., Waltham, MA, USA).

ionization_type.evidence: Samples were analyzed on a Q Exactive mass spectrometer interfaced with an Easy-nLC 1000 nano LC system (both Thermo Fisher Scientific, Inc., Waltham, MA, USA).

labeling.evidence: Pre-fractionated plasma samples from twelve patients with AAA and eight matched controls without aneurysm were analyzed by mass spectrometry applying a tandem mass tag (TMT) technique.

mass_analyzer.evidence: Samples were analyzed on a Q Exactive mass spectrometer interfaced with an Easy-nLC 1000 nano LC system (both Thermo Fisher Scientific, Inc., Waltham, MA, USA).

ptm.evidence: Tryptic peptides were accepted with one missed cleavage and variable modifications of methionine oxidation, cysteine methylthiolation and fixed modifications of N-terminal TMT6plex and lysine TMT6plex were selected.
